programmes.name_local: صندوق العمل تمكين - برنامج دعم الأعمال
programmes.amount_note: Co-matching grants covering a share (commonly 50%, higher for some categories) of equipment, marketing, digital tools, consultancy and business development costs for Bahraini enterprises. Ceilings vary by enterprise size and are published per programme.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the Tamkeen portal; individual programmes open and close as budgets are allocated each year.
programmes.reopen_note: Tamkeen restructures its programme portfolio annually; when a programme closes, an equivalent successor is normally launched in the new fiscal year on tamkeen.bh.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the enterprise on the Tamkeen portal.
Submit quotations and the business case.
Approval, then reimbursement or direct payment to the supplier.

eligibility.other_note: Bahraini-registered enterprises; many programmes require Bahraini ownership and prioritise Bahraini employment.

programmes.amount_note: Six months of hands-on support across commercialisation, product development, fundraising and team development. The programme is fully funded by Tamkeen; there is no published cash grant to participants.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based; intake windows are announced on tamkeen.bh.
programmes.reopen_note: Tamkeen runs Riyada cohorts periodically with partner operators (including a track powered by Salica Investments for tech entrepreneurs); new cohorts are announced on the Tamkeen programmes page.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online during an open cohort window.

documents_required.doc: Bahraini CR or commitment to register

eligibility.other_note: Bahrain-based startups; the programme is fully supported by Tamkeen.

programmes.source_snippet: The program offers hands-on and practical support over the course of six months in four main areas: commercialization, product development, fundraising, and team development.
